title: fix(objectql): a refused member of a multi-package artifact leaves no member of it registered (#31564)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi934LugcHrYQZvw8K1SD7K3S)_

domain:server#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmPsKvRzUCdA1j8gTUX

Fixes #31564

Clause-②: yes (widening) — adds one public method, `SchemaRegistry.recordRestoreOnRefusal` (re-exported through `@objectstack/objectql`'s index), and refuses nothing that registers today.
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：引擎的 `manifest` 服务把一个多包产物的所有成员包（以及产物的"残余"顶层项）放进同一个注册还原事务里注册。任何一处被拒，所有成员写过的东西一起撤回：注册表条目、导航贡献、引擎自己的 manifest 表和数据源定义表。
- 为什么改：以前每个包只撤回自己。后面的成员被拒时，前面已注册的成员留在运行中的内核里；安装接口回 422、不写安装记录，重启后又消失。首装时内核在服务一个被拒的安装，升级时第一个成员变成了被拒的 2.0.0 而第二个还是 1.0.0。
- 风险与回滚：拒绝的判定一个没改，接受和拒绝的范围与今天完全一样，只是拒绝后内核状态回到产物到达之前。新增一个注册表方法 `recordRestoreOnRefusal`，让引擎把自己表里的写入登记到同一个还原事务。回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts`（`manifest.register` 里包住整个产物的那一段），`packages/objectql/src/engine-registration.ts`（`registerApp` 登记 manifest 和数据源定义），`packages/objectql/src/registry.ts`（`recordRestoreOnRefusal` 和导航贡献的登记）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql exec vitest run src/manifest-service-artifact-refusal-restores.test.ts`，预期 10 个全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**The choice: (a) in its strongest form — one restore run spans the whole artifact.** `manifest.register` (`packages/objectql/src/plugin.ts`) now runs every package body of the artifact, and then its residual, inside one `SchemaRegistry.restoringOnRefusal` run. Each `registerApp` already opens such a run for its own body; a nested call joins the open run, so a refusal anywhere in the artifact puts back every entry ANY member wrote, and the refusal reaches the caller unchanged (same code, status and sentence).

What a refused artifact now leaves:
- **First install:** no member registered — no package record, object, app, page, navigation contribution, kind, datasource definition, namespace claim or engine manifest entry of any member.
- **Upgrade:** the installed version of EVERY member keeps serving, whole. On `main` the first member became the refused `2.0.0` while the second stayed `1.0.0`.
- **A residual refusal** (top-level items no body declares, registered after every body): the same — no member registered.

To make "every entry" true, three writes that sat outside the run are now recorded in it:
1. `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` — each app's list of navigation contributions (`setPackageNavContributions`, `registerAppNavContribution`), recorded before its first write in a run.
2. `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` — `recordRestoreOnRefusal(key, capture)`, a new public method: an engine map a package body writes beside the registry is recorded in the open run, the way the registry records its own entries. Outside a run it records nothing.
3. `packages/objectql/src/engine-registration.ts` — `registerApp` records, through it, the engine's `manifests` entry and each datasource definition (restored with the driver floor `applyExternalDriverFloor` decides), and drops the summary index again on restore.

A single-package artifact is the same one-body run as before: outside a multi-member run nothing new is recorded, and every refusal is raised at the same place.

One ordering change in `plugin.ts`: the residual owner's origin (`ObjectQL.recordResidualOwner`) is now recorded once the artifact has registered whole, not before. A recorded `marketplace` origin is never taken back, so recording it for a refused artifact left a stale origin for an id nothing registered. No reader runs during registration (searched: the only reader is `service-automation`'s, after the door answers), and the bridge that follows still sees it.

### Why (a) in this form, and not (b), on the four axes

- **Real business need.** The reach is every install-local of a multi-package artifact (inline, and the cloud branch since #31563) whose later member the engine refuses, and every boot of such a stack. The measured symptom is a kernel that serves an install it answered `422` for, until the next restart. Both branches measured red on `main` (below).
- **Long-term soundness.** (b) "check the whole artifact before any member registers" cannot see the refusals that matter: most are raised by the registry's own verbs part-way, against state the earlier members just wrote (the artifact's own object-name conflict reads member one's object; the ADR-0130 D1 co-owner gate reads member one's namespace). A pre-check would have to re-implement every verb's judge against a simulated registry — the second copy ADR-0130's comment on this door forbids. Literal (a), "withdraw the members already registered", would go through `uninstallPackage`, which refuses an object another package extends, drops a tenant's overlay with its owner (ADR-0029 D9.7), and cannot put an upgrade's installed version back. The restore run (#28697) already exists for exactly this, records only what the run writes, and already restores an upgrade whole for one body; spanning it over the artifact is the root fix, not a second mechanism.
- **Preventing AI mistakes.** The refusal stays loud and unchanged; only what is left behind changes. No lenient path is added and nothing is tolerated that was refused before. An AI author retrying a corrected artifact meets a clean kernel instead of half of its previous attempt.
- **Startup focus.** No new door, no new authorable surface, no spec change. One new public method on `SchemaRegistry` (listed in open questions for the seat).

### Forced test edits

- `packages/objectql/src/registry-artifact-co-ownership.test.ts` — "leaves NOTHING behind when it refuses": it read `com.acme.crm` (the member registered before the refused one) as still registered, still the `crm` namespace owner and still `crm_account`'s owner. Those three reads were the defect. It now asserts neither member, no namespace owner and no definition of `crm_account`.
- `packages/cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-register-refusal.test.ts` — the "object name two packages of one artifact define" case listed only the refused member as unregistered, with a comment saying the earlier one stays and is "not pinned here". It now lists both members (the cloud-branch pin), and a new inline-branch case sits beside it in the same harness.
- `packages/objectql/src/registry-module-mock.ts` — the registry double gains `recordRestoreOnRefusal: vi.fn()`; an omitted member is a hard `TypeError` at `registerApp`'s first call.

## Tests

New `packages/objectql/src/manifest-service-artifact-refusal-restores.test.ts` (10 cases, real `ObjectKernel` + `ObjectQLPlugin`, artifacts arriving after `start()` through the `manifest` service):
- fresh install, second member refused by a registry verb part-way (an object another installed package owns), by the artifact's own object-name conflict, and by a body-only judge (an item wearing another package's `_packageId`): neither member registered, the refusal keeps its code and status, the holder unchanged;
- a refusal the residual raises after both members registered: neither registered, and no residual-owner origin recorded;
- upgrade `1.0.0` → `2.0.0`, second member refused (the same three ways): the trace (packages, objects with labels, apps, pages, navigation, kinds, datasource definitions, engine manifests and their versions, namespaces) reads exactly as before;
- CONTROLS: a single-package refusal answers exactly what a bare `registerApp` answers (code, status, message) and leaves nothing; a clean two-member artifact registers both; a clean artifact with a residual records the residual owner's origin.

Cloud-connection, in the #31478 harness: the cloud-branch case now pins both members unregistered; a new inline-branch case pins the same.

### Red on main first (645ed3d1, objectql and cloud-connection src unchanged)

<details><summary>objectql: 7 failed | 2 passed (9) — the controls are the passes</summary>

```
× a fresh install whose second member is refused: an object another installed package owns (a registry verb, part-way)
× a fresh install whose second member is refused: an object name the first member also defines (the artifact's own conflict)
× a fresh install whose second member is refused: a page wearing another package's `_packageId` (judged from the body alone)
× a refusal the artifact's residual raises, after both members registered
× the second member of 2.0.0 is refused: (the same three)
 Tests  7 failed | 2 passed (9)
```
Fresh install: `"packages": ["com.probe.suite.core@1.0.0", "com.probe.suite.addon@-"]` with core's object, app, page, navigation contribution, kind, datasource definition and engine manifest still present. Upgrade: core read `@2.0.0` (`suite_core_thing:…:core 2.0.0`, `suite_nav_2_0_0`, `suite.kind.2.0.0`) while the addon read `@1.0.0`. (The residual-owner pin was added after this run; leg 4 below is its red.)
</details>

<details><summary>cloud-connection: 2 failed | 10 passed (12) — both branches</summary>

```
× a fresh install of an object name two packages of one artifact define is refused: 422 with the engine's sentence, nothing registered or ledgered
  AssertionError: com.acme.crm: expected { manifest: { …(6) }, …(6) } to be undefined
× the inline branch: a multi-package artifact whose second member is refused leaves neither member registered
  AssertionError: expected { manifest: { …(6) }, …(6) } to be undefined
 Tests  2 failed | 10 passed (12)
```
The 10 passes include every single-package refusal case (the CONTROL: answered as today).
</details>

### Ablations (fix committed first; `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restore proven blob == HEAD each leg)

Tests resolve `@objectstack/objectql` from `src` (objectql's own suite imports `./plugin.js`; cloud-connection aliases `@objectstack/objectql` to `../objectql/src/index.ts`), so no `dist` leg is involved.

<details><summary>four legs, each red, each restored</summary>

1. **The artifact run removed** — `plugin.ts` `ql.registry.restoringOnRefusal(() => {` → `((run: () => void) => run())(() => {` (blob `b1ac4873` → `30e786cd`): objectql `Tests 8 failed | 17 passed (25)` (the 7 refusal pins + the co-ownership pin), cloud-connection `Tests 2 failed | 10 passed (12)` (cloud + inline). Restored `b1ac4873` == HEAD.
2. **Outside entries not recorded** — `registry.ts` `recordRestoreOnRefusal` body → `void key; void capture;` (blob `9d12f869` → `ae44483e`): `Tests 7 failed | 3 passed (10)`, the diffs on `datasources` and `manifests`. Restored == HEAD.
3. **Navigation contributions not recorded** — `registry.ts` `noteAppNavContributions` made to skip its note (`this.restorePoint` → `(app ? undefined : this.restorePoint)`) (blob `9d12f869` → `ad4684e2`): `Tests 7 failed | 3 passed (10)`, the diff on `nav` (`com.probe.suite.core:suite_nav_1_0_0` left behind). Restored == HEAD.
4. **Residual owner recorded before the run** (main's order) — (blob `b1ac4873` → `c44f3509`): `Tests 1 failed | 9 passed (10)`, `expected 'marketplace' to be undefined`. Restored == HEAD.

A first attempt at legs 3 and 4 was refused by the tool before running anything (the replacement contained the anchor, so the anchor count did not drop); re-planted with replacements that do not contain it.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- `ObjectQL.recordResidualOwner`'s record is sticky by design (`marketplace` never turns into `code`); this PR only stops writing it for a refused artifact.
- Bridging into the metadata service already ran after all registration, so a refused artifact never reached the metadata service on `main` either; unchanged.

## Verification

Head **`dcec15bd`**: `6cc7467a` (fix + pins, merged with `origin/main` at `6b83ec2d`; the merge touched neither objectql nor cloud-connection) plus one commit that changes only the changeset's `Clause-②:` line. The readings below were taken on `6cc7467a`; on `dcec15bd` the changeset families were re-run: `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main`, `check-changeset-no-major --base origin/main`, `check-empty-changeset --base origin/main`, `check:changeset-gate-self-tests`, `check:closed-ceremony-text`, each exit 0.

- `turbo run build --concurrency=2 --filter='./packages/**'` after the merge: `Tasks: 81 successful, 81 total` (os-verify-lock VERDICT command-exit 0).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql test`: `Test Files 571 passed (571)`, `Tests 11581 passed (11581)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cloud-connection test`: `Test Files 78 passed (78)`, `Tests 1066 passed (1066)`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql typecheck` and `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cloud-connection typecheck`: exit 0 (same lock run, VERDICT command-exit 0).
